TabBarItem.summary: Single tab button in a tab bar: notifies its parent TabBar to select it when clicked. Inherits from Button.

props.caption: Tab label; default 'tab'. The parent TabBar matches the selection by it
props.height: Height; default "100%", i.e. fills the parent
props.noFont: When true the text is not drawn; default false

TabBarItem:SetCaption.desc: Sets the tab label and invalidates when it changed; the current implementation does not notify the parent TabBar to re-layout.

TabBarItem:MouseDown.desc: On press, calls parent:Select(self.caption) to select itself, then runs Button's press logic.

Mouse arguments, forwarded to the parent

fileDesc: A single tab button inside a tab bar; clicking it asks the parent TabBar to select it.
